description: Who changed what on the ChatGPT Ads account and when: each create/update with its actor and every changed field’s before and after value. Read it first when a campaign starts or stops spending unexpectedly. Filter by campaignId (includes its ad groups and ads), adGroupId, adId, actorId, since/until (date, ISO time or unix seconds). Read-only, 0 credits.

actorId.description: only changes made by this actor id

adGroupId.description: only changes to this ad group

after.description: pagination cursor for the next page

before.description: pagination cursor for the previous page

campaignId.description: include changes to this campaign and its ad groups and ads

since.description: start of the window: date, ISO time or unix seconds

until.description: end of the window: date, ISO time or unix seconds

name: list_openai_ads_audit_logs
title: ChatGPT Ads change history (audit log)
